analysis.limitations: Same-mesh port comparisons freeze original input bytes. Remeshing also changes geometry and continuous-traction integration; original force-point/wrench changes are retained. Raw peaks remain global and unsmoothed. Prescribed-reference traction admissibility and resolved-contact acceptance remain separate. No new physical acceptance or paired GPU speedup is claimed.

limitations: Port resolution is an explicit numerical axis with fixed physical radius/friction/wrenches and unchanged complete acceptance tolerances. Same-mesh input bytes are checked. Combined remeshing retains changes in force application points and wrenches. Pure pressure requires no intrinsic-distance cache. Raw full fields, failures and source remain exact. Earlier baseline fields are in their existing publications and are not duplicated. Converged full egg/Franka/interior-hotspot contact and complete physical operating-range acceptance remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
